Entity.Title: School of Nursing and Midwifery, East Africa

Title: Faculty celebration dinner
NewsSummary: SONAM -EA held a celebration dinner to acknowledge faculty for their hard work and dedication.
NewsContent:
During the 4-day research retreat, the School took the opportunity to hold a celebration dinner to acknowledge faculty for their hard work and dedication. Notably, acknowledgements included: Joseph Mwizerwa (Academic Head, SONAM-Kampala), Abubaker Mohammed, Moses Wankiiri and Carolyne Namukwaya, all of whom recently completed their Post Graduate Diploma in Medical Education at Makerere University, Uganda; Gladys Mbuthia, Sindhu Ramalingam, Grace Nakate, Cliff Aliga, Jane Kabo and Joan Musau who successfully completed the first year of their PhD at UNiSA and secured ethics approval; and Edna Tallam (CEO/Registrar, Nursing Council of Kenya), Isabel Kambo, Diana Kassaman, Judith Mutyabule, Joseph Mwizerwa, Samuel Mulongo and Victor Mathias for successful completion of the Stellenbosch University pre-doctorate programme. 

The School also congratulated faculty who were awarded research grants. Diana Kassaman was awarded a competitive grant from the Beginning Investigations Grant for Catalytic Research to support her research entitled, Exploring Health Literacy Levels of Women Diagnosed with Cervical and/or Breast Cancer in Kenya. Dr Agnes Msoka won a University Research Council grant to support her research, Exploring Barriers to Tanzanian Men's Uptake of Vasectomy Services. Grace Nakate won a Teaching and Learning grant to support her research, A Descriptive Study Comparing Nurse-led Clinical Teaching Rounds with Standard Post Conference in Promoting Critical Thinking Skills Among Undergraduate Nurses. Ms Nakate was also recognized for having the most downloaded research article (Knowledge and Attitudes of Select Ugandan Nurses Towards Documentation of Patient Care) in the first half of 2017. Finally, Loveluck Mwasha was recognized for receiving the coveted 2017 Midwife for Life Award at the International Confederation of Midwives conference in Toronto, Canada.
